summary: Independent DAY discovery pass found one credible outside-250 public challenger signal (TREO rare-earths), two non-public structural weak signals (Relativity Space launch-service validation and Vitestro robotic phlebotomy), and reconfirmed AV certification as a distinct regulatory-throughput constraint. The pass cannot claim acquisitionComplete because FINRA OTC Daily List remains partition-freshness only and row-level current corporate-action acquisition is unavailable through the present lawful interface; therefore the cadence directive stays open and discoveryScanCompleted must remain false.

materialFindings.finding: Tactical Resources Corp. (TREO) began Nasdaq Capital Market trading on 2026-08-20 after its business combination and is not present in the current Earth repo search. Its Peak Project is a U.S.-focused rare-earth development asset in West Texas with already-mined material and existing infrastructure. This is a credible outside-250 strategic-materials challenger, but admission requires identity/capitalization/project-economics underwriting rather than narrative promotion.

NHTSA's 2026 Cybercab audit and purpose-built AV exemption/rulemaking actions support treating certification/regulatory throughput as a real constraint distinct from raw autonomy capability. The evidence is regulatory and entity-level; it should be tested structurally before any company score effect.

NASA added private Relativity Space's Terran R to the NLS II launch-services contract on 2026-09-09. This is not a public-equity admission signal, but it is independent validation that reusable heavy-launch capacity is broadening and may migrate the space bottleneck from launch-provider scarcity toward payload, range, communications, insurance and mission-integration constraints.

FDA granted De Novo marketing authorization to Vitestro's Aletta, the first standalone robotic blood-draw device, with one trained phlebotomist able to supervise up to three devices. This is a verified physical-AI/health automation weak signal and a candidate graph dependency around labor scarcity plus regulated clinical robotics; Vitestro is not established here as a public admission candidate.

Cadence review used current machine health for USAspending, ClinicalTrials.gov and FDA; reviewed Cboe's 2026 new-listing notices, NASA procurement/award updates, DOE/NRC/NHTSA/NIST official material, and searched SEC/Nasdaq/NYSE discovery surfaces. Cboe's visible recent operating-company signal was empty in the retrieved set and its recent entries were ETFs. FINRA remains the blocking capability gap: current state proves partition freshness only, explicitly eventDataAvailable=false, and the public OTCE page did not expose row-level additions to this tool session.
